svg.title: The stairwell and the corridor, half past twelve
svg.desc: A four-storey stairwell and corridor seen in section, with a sign on nearly every door, a lift with a handwritten notice taped to it, a cleaner waiting beside it with a trolley, and two students on the stairs both keeping to the same side.

g.text: ENTRANCE
EXIT
The stairwell and the corridor, half past twelve
Fourteen things to find. Three of the signs are written by three different hands.
floor 3 - two doors, two signs
floor 2 - the toilet, and the queue
floor 1 - the exam room
the entrance
the stairs - everybody, all four floors
floor 3
floor 2
floor 1
the lift
the lift - a piece of paper decides
the corridor - two people wide, if they both move
the entrance - one, for everybody
one student going up, on the left
one student coming down, also on the left
Dona Filipa - staff, and she takes the stairs
Ana - she counted the signs
the noticeboard, below the sign about it
a student looking for the exit that is not locked
the exit - three, two of them locked
